stories.text: 🪦 Gather 'round: Mel's Mediocre Mob's obituary has been posted (13.24 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Mr. Action Jackson vs Gibb it to Me Baby. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Mr. Action Jackson 79% / 52%, Gibb it to Me Baby 77% / 46%.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 73% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 33% with none (now 53%).
💥 BYE-MAGEDDON: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy has 4 starters on bye this week (Barkley, Egbuka, Loveland and Santos). Somebody call *NSYNC.
🔁 Trade that should have happened: Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1 would have helped both TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace!.
⚠️ ELIMINATION WATCH: TDsMaGee could be officially out of the race for a playoff spot as soon as next week.
⚠️ ELIMINATION WATCH: Kirbo Crushers could be officially out of the race for a playoff spot as soon as next week.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Uriel's Upbeat Team leads the chopping-block odds at 54%, with Joe's Scary Team next at 46%.
🤝 Rivalry week: Gibb it to Me Baby leads Mr. Action Jackson 4–3 all-time.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 10: Brock You Like a Hurricane 44%, Kyle Tucker 16%, Gibb it to Me Baby 9.1%.
🔁 Retro trade: Had Ramosverse and Mr. Action Jackson swapped Douglas and McBride for Monangai and Flowers back in Week 1, both would be ahead (+2 wins each).
🤔 What could have been: If TDsMaGee and Mr. Action Jackson had swapped Jayden Daniels for Tyler Warren back in Week 6, both would be ahead (+1 and +3 wins).
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 13% against Mr. Action Jackson — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted Mr. Action Jackson after the favorite flipped 8 times.
